is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on the common bed bug, Cimex lectularius L. (Hemiptera: Cimicidae) (Title, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports on kdr mutations in bed bugs (L925I), not the target markers for Anopheles (Page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data for Anopheles markers is reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The specimens were collected in Parramatta, New South Wales, Australia (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study investigating cuticle thickening in bed bugs.

assessment.summary: This study investigates cuticle thickening as a resistance mechanism in pyrethroid-resistant bed bugs (Cimex lectularius) collected in Australia. It does not study Anopheles mosquitoes or African populations, and does not report on the target insecticide resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: The study focuses on bed bugs (Cimex lectularius), not Anopheles mosquitoes.
The study does not report on any of the target insecticide resistance markers.
The study does not provide extractable genotype data for Anopheles markers.
The study population is from Australia, not Africa.
